{{Top|leg}}
'''Guild Enforcers''' were the paramilitary arm of the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]]. They were deployed when the interests of the Mining Guild were threatened, in an effort to protect their assets. Enforcers were used to protect the Guild against [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] raids, wars, and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] strikes.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
